summary: Held policy changes send one mail instead of many, and you approve them where you read them.

new.title: Approve from the Approvals page
new.text: The mail now points to Reviews & controls > Approvals, which always shows the current held change with Approve this change set at the top.

fixes.title: One mail per held change
fixes.text: A held policy change used to send a mail on every run. It now mails once, again only if it gets weaker or once a day while it stands.

fixes.title: Shorter Policy templates page
fixes.text: The Policy templates page has a one-line introduction, folded help and one card per default template.
